notes: Partition verified: 21 source and 37 target IDs each used exactly once.
אוֹתָהּ stands on the appositive itself, so the marker rightly takes *even* here (rule 16), unlike the unlicensed *even* of vv. 21, 31 and 32.
The ASV inverts אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּיּוֹת into *the nether parts of the earth*, so the *of* stands with אֶרֶץ, which the English has made the dependent.
